title: The Ghost in the Machine has an American accent: value conflict in GPT-3.

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model to summarize value-rich texts from non-US cultures (e.g., Australian laws, French policies, German speeches) and comparing the embedded values in the outputs to dominant US values using the World Values Survey.

Summarizing political texts and policies regarding topics like gun control, immigration, and abortion to observe if the model's outputs shift the original text's meaning toward dominant US political stances.

Summarizing feminist literature (e.g., Simone de Beauvoir) and women's rights declarations to observe if the model generates outputs containing patriarchal, misogynistic, or sexually biased misinterpretations.
Summarizing texts advocating for LGBTI rights (e.g., a speech from LGBTI Pride in Spain) to observe if the model alters the meaning to misrepresent the movement or oppose LGBTI equality.
Summarizing French official texts on secularism (laïcité) to observe if the model mischaracterizes the policy through a US-centric lens regarding religious freedom and anti-Muslim sentiment.

Summarizing civil rights texts (e.g., Malcolm X's speeches) to observe if the model fails to reproduce the original anti-racist values and instead hallucinates politically polarized or historically inaccurate statements.
